audit.title: Audit of the original portal
audit.lead: A review of 181.49.177.91 across three dimensions — content, voice and internationalization — and the redesign decisions that came out of it.

items.evidence: The newest story is dated 24 September 2019 and the menu still offers “Old press room”.
items.fix: Service notices with relative dates, a live status strip and a single press room.

items.finding: Navigation is organised around institutional verbs
items.evidence: “Súbete”, “Conoce”, “Actúa”, “Transita” and “Entérate” give no clue what is inside.
items.fix: A menu built from real tasks: Routes and stops, Indicators, Contact, Accessibility.

items.finding: All 23 routes are listed one by one in the menu
items.evidence: “RUTA C1” through “RUTA C16” and “RUTA E1” through “RUTA E7” as loose menu items.
items.fix: A route explorer with search, filters and a detail page per route.

items.finding: Noise competes with the main task
items.evidence: A hit counter (555,903), a satisfaction poll and a Facebook widget fill the sidebar.
items.fix: All removed; public metrics move to the indicators page, backed by verifiable data.

items.evidence: No fare, no service hours and no headways anywhere on the home page.
items.fix: Fare, hours and headway on the first screen and on every route page.

items.finding: An administrative register, not a civic one
items.evidence: “In an Extraordinary Session the Board of Avante Approves the Second Phase of the Fleet Management and Control System…”
items.fix: Sentence-case headlines, verb up front, twelve words maximum.

items.evidence: SETP, SGCF, PQRS and AVANTE all appear undefined on the home page.
items.fix: First mention always spelled out, with a contextual glossary on hover.

items.evidence: “EIGHT ROUTES TEMPORARILY CHANGE THEIR CORRIDOR DUE TO WORKS…”
items.fix: Caps only on route badges — screen readers spell out full capitals.

items.finding: The rider is written about in the third person
items.evidence: “Our users give us their valuable opinions regarding the service…”
items.fix: Consistent second person across the interface: “Tap your card when you board.”

items.evidence: The lang attribute is hard-coded to “es-ES” and there is no language switcher.
items.fix: Four locales with their own routes (/es, /en, /pt, /ar), Accept-Language negotiation and hreflang links.

items.finding: The declared locale is not the audience's
items.evidence: es-ES (Spain) is declared for a Colombian transit system.
items.fix: es-CO as the base locale: Colombian date, time, number and currency formats.

items.evidence: “Created on Martes, 24 Septiembre 2019” and the “Back” button in the mobile menu.
items.fix: 100% of strings live in versioned dictionaries; no string is left in a template.

items.finding: Dates and numbers formatted by hand
items.evidence: “Martes, 24 Septiembre 2019” — missing the Spanish preposition — and inconsistent thousands separators.
items.fix: Formatting delegated to the Intl API: dates, numbers, currency, plurals and relative time.

items.finding: The layout is welded to left-to-right
items.evidence: Fixed pixel margins and floats, with no logical properties anywhere.
items.fix: Logical properties throughout, so Arabic re-flows the interface with no separate stylesheet.

items.evidence: Carousel banners carry their message burned into the JPG.
items.fix: HTML text over the image: translatable, selectable and readable by screen readers.

audit.scoreLead: The heuristic applied to the original portal and to this redesign, scored from 0 to 100.
